scope: Bounded full-120-item source figure/formula/subpart completeness challenge, not a new blind key review or exhaustive course-wide semantic deduplication.
method: Personally inspect all59 actual page pixels, including58 substantive pages and55 end-only; compare every current assignment adaptation and rationale, investigate branches/tables/multipart requests, and reuse existing assessed reasoning instead of generating numeric variants.
priorExposure: Printed highlighted source keys and generated answers/solutions were visible during completeness comparison. No blind-answer claim is made; existing sealed independent answer records are untouched.
limitations: Presence and current-hash review links do not imply all current questions are accepted. Integration must apply separate independent answer and quality reviews.
No browser, package, model, hardware, NLTK, ROS or external notebook execution occurred.
Not every distractor, unused graph edge or different numeric value requires a separate question; preserved original-item provenance is distinct from new assessed knowledge.
The two known W04 duplicate-reuse decisions are unresolved in this frozen snapshot; W06 branch addition is pending separate author/reviewer.

supersedes.reason: Two reviewer note copy errors corrected before handoff: W04 Q005 is accuracy/repeatability, and Q008 is elastic-link compliance. Item mappings, source evidence, gap counts and conclusions unchanged.
